question: An educational fund of ₹6,00,000 earns simple interest at 9% per annum. This annual interest is used to grant three scholarships. If the first and third scholarships are ₹18,000 and ₹22,000 respectively, what is the value of the second scholarship?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total annual interest = 9% of ₹6,00,000 = ₹54,000.

Sum of the first and third scholarships = ₹18,000 + ₹22,000 = ₹40,000.

Second scholarship = Total interest − Sum of first and third scholarships.

Second scholarship = 54,000 − 40,000 = ₹14,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹14,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Educational Fund Principal (P) = ₹6,00,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 9% per annum

Time (T) = 1 year

First scholarship = ₹18,000

Third scholarship = ₹22,000

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (I) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100
